name: The Astrolabe Rift Promontory
core_rationale: Northern cliff-edge promontory of Rustcog Downs at [1, 0] where Krono's outermost astrolabe ring points skyward toward the shattered gravity halo of Continent 03.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider scouts swear that brass bolts dropped from the Astrolabe Promontory fall upward into the violet clouds whenever the three moons align.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A fractured thirty-meter brass astrolabe ring hovering half-detached above a sheer copper canyon rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where is the Star-Pendulum key required to stabilize the dimensional rift to Continent 03?

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors the locked Astrolabe Gate travel link between Continent 02 (The Clockwork Steppe) and Continent 03 (The Shattered Halo).

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Hovering brass astrolabe ring where bolts and pebbles drift upward into violet storm clouds.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics will be bound when promoted to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved at [1, 0] North of Brass Spur Ridge via a fog_of_lore boundary portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null and compiles to a fog_of_lore boundary portal on Brass Spur Ridge North Gate.
